component.name: Hinterland
component.summary: A fast, secure and freely customisable browser

description.p: Hinterland is a fast, private, and customisable Chromium/Electron web browser designed for focus and security.

ul.li: Built-in tracker blocking, HTTPS-First navigation, DNT, and per-site shields
Tab Groups Studio, Tab Stash, Reader Mode, and Quick Notes
Zero-knowledge AES-256-GCM password manager and MV3 Extension SDK
